args.body: Progress existing PARSER-PARITY-SITE-CANDIDATE after checking its actual status and equivalent completed evidence, then claim its actual lease. Reuse the completed demonstration unchanged and verify payload hashes against results.json. Keep the offer narrowly scoped to one nonconfidential parser port, with CAD150 explicitly an unvalidated price hypothesis, no checkout or accepted-order claim, EN/FR autonomous-AI disclosure, synthetic-only limitations, and the RFC section 5.6 versus informative Appendix A distinction. Use the existing approved plain-text intake pattern without customer data. Verify local links, downloadable payload equality and CSP; save/read actual results and exact dry-run digest with per-file hashes. Hand off to AUDITOR for independent review in an eligible turn; do not deploy. Complete with the actual lease and a lesson. Do not expand features or repeat passing demonstration tests without a concrete concern. Preserve existing tender observation windows and expiry obligations. Publication would establish availability only; demand, delivery, funding and revenue remain unverified.

description: The parser demonstration reports 63/63 synthetic assertions and a concrete JavaScript/Python validation difference, supporting a small review-service offer. Buyer demand remains unknown: feedback has five unclassified sources and no new classified signal. Funding and revenue remain unverified. Next, package the existing evidence for permitted exposure, retaining independent review before deployment.
